source_name: AHU Online — Legal Entity Registry (Ditjen AHU)
organization: Direktorat Jenderal Administrasi Hukum Umum, Ministry of Law (Kemenkumham)
rate_limits: free profile search; full profiles/documents paid (PNBP); no open bulk; host firewalled from this environment
notes: Authoritative legal-entity registry for PT, CV, Firma, Yayasan, Perkumpulan (Ministry of Law). Holds nama PT, nomor SK pengesahan badan hukum, NPWP, modal/capital, pengurus & pemegang saham. Public 'Pencarian Profil' exists; full profiles/documents are PAID (PNBP). No open bulk/API. ahu.go.id resolved via DNS (103.200.129.129) but TCP/HTTP timed out from this environment — documented from public knowledge; no values captured. Pengurus/pemegang saham = personal data, redact.

rate_limits: per-company NIB search (JS SPA); no open bulk/API
notes: Online Single Submission (BKPM). Issues the NIB (Nomor Induk Berusaha, 13-digit) — the modern business id — and risk-based licenses with KBLI activity codes. Public 'Cari NIB' search (oss.go.id/id/pencarian), per-company, JS-driven. No open bulk register; OSS/BKPM publishes aggregate investment statistics only. NIB is the join key to the modern business identity.

organization: PT Bursa Efek Indonesia (Indonesia Stock Exchange)
rate_limits: public via browser; Cloudflare challenge (HTTP 403) on automated requests
notes: Indonesia Stock Exchange — the open source of LISTED-company financial statements (laporan keuangan) and annual reports (~900 companies, e.g. BBCA, TLKM, ASII). Public via browser but Cloudflare-gated (403 'Attention Required') for automation — not bypassed. Listed only; private financials not public.

source_name: Satu Data Indonesia — national open-data portal
notes: National open-data portal (works). Hosts regional/sectoral statistics (health, agriculture, education, MSME counts by kabupaten) — NOT a national company register. CKAN-style API not at the standard /api/3 path. Useful for sector/statistics context only.
